integrity: Complete all-order constructive proof supplied. Independent direct cutwidth/BFS verifier reproduced the metric and enumerators for 35 finite cases. Finite tests are not the proof.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted individually labelled stars and cutwidth only; no claim for arbitrary trees, weighted cutwidth, pathwidth, or counts of distinct geodesics. Equivalent older positional-window results remain possible.
title: Sharp cutwidth-constrained order reconfiguration on stars
